findings.source_reason: The authored long research request explicitly says rating above 3.5. The expected native field set has rating_min=3.5 but omits strictness, so a >=3.5 projection can incorrectly pass the predeclared oracle.

Native GlobalQuerySearch populates entitlement-derived online only when formats or availability positive fields are present; excluded_formats alone is omitted. A raw native negative-only ONLINE plan can therefore accept entitled online records incorrectly.
findings.required_precondition: Before retaining EXECUTABLE pre-register tested isolated entitlement derivation and both pre/post-hydration predicate enforcement; interpretation must use trusted authenticated actor entitlement, not model-proposed metadata.

suggested_overlay.if_missing_operand_first_policy: INCOMPLETE with unsupported capability explicitly recorded; numeric completion must remain nonexecutable

accepted_source_semantics: Ordinary topical discovery executable without invented taxonomy or metadata filters.
Dates governed by history-topic text stay semantic; published-after year is institutional-only.
Free-to-borrow may remain access-preference semantic text, not an automatic commercial price comparison.
Explicit title-only substring unsupported; general title-or-author and normalized identity are separate native operations.
Rating comparisons, missing supported operands, contradictions, unsupported metadata and unsupported sort directions are distinguishable.
Text attempting scope escalation cannot choose scope and may remain nonoperative while a valid ecology objective executes in trusted scope.
Empty input nonexecution is valid; UNSUPPORTED versus INCOMPLETE is a typed policy choice rather than native retrieval fact.
limits: The review is independent of candidate predictions/implementation but is not fresh independent acceptance or an external human review.
Substring preservation and native projection labels are development transport/interpretation oracles, not book-result relevance judgments.
No parser, native provider, DB, JWT, HNSW, model, or production route was executed by this reviewer.
Corrections must be recorded in a versioned reviewed overlay with provenance; the authored cohort remains immutable.
This reviewer cannot verify whether predictions exist elsewhere; it has not opened, requested or used any.
